# 朝华打字机 / ZhaohuaTypeWriter

- Font: `ZhaohuaTypeWriter.ttf`, version 1.001, by TerryWang (特里王).
- Downloaded 2026-09-27 from the [unofficial GitHub mirror](https://github.com/BH1PHL/ttf-terrywang-typewriter-fonts), which identifies the original author and version.
- The accompanying `LICENSE.txt` is the mirror's copy of the author's custom statement. The [author's release article](https://zhuanlan.zhihu.com/p/2016544991133073839) and [font catalog](https://fonts.zeoseven.com/items/2103/) are additional provenance references.
- The statement permits commercial use and embedding in software, prohibits selling the font as a font asset, and allows redistribution. Preserve the copyright and statement with the font.
- Intended only for the Chinese print text of the mind reasoning interface. Downloading this font does not change any current scene reference.
